title: Bind the first QQ16 query copy to a paid tape protocol
body:
This closes one literal physical access/return obligation at PR #4015's first streamed query and identifies the exact adapter still missing before it. It is a source-bound local tape result, with no claim that the actual global caller already supplies these windows.

The full recovery word has `CLEAR Z2 query2` at event1697 and no intervening Z2 reference before `ADD Z2 Z10 1` at event1708. That actual first query update is therefore exactly a bitwise copy. The paid CLEAR remains, Z10 is preserved, and Z2 becomes a live query sum; no saving is deferred to cleanup.

The implementation supplies an explicit same-tape tagged-window contract: source Z10 and destination Z2 are disjoint bank-major intervals with displacement H, identical owner/address tags and common signed component format. For S=M*2^(n*lambda), d=n²+n*lambda, L=d+2W+2, C=SL+2, H=C+gap and P=2SW payload bits, a literal one-bit shuttle costs exactly **P READ + P WRITE + [2PH+2(d+2)] MOVE actions**. Every unit seek and the final origin return is charged. Source bits, tags/fences, gap/exterior and all spectator tapes/heads are preserved. It removes exactly **2SW redundant destination reads** relative to the identical transfer schedule with an old-destination read; this does not change PR4015's scalar allowance. Motion is minimal only within the explicitly restricted paired one-bit shuttle class. Its quadratic full-cover cost is a conservative reference, not a favorable global-layout proposal.

The preceding source events are pinned: map1706 uses stage2/port1 on Z10, native1707 uses the **negative q=19** line, followed by four query accumulations. The actual recipe's two basis permutations and affine offset19 are checked on512 columns. A valid signed, even-numerator basis witness rejects replacing that whole native event with a bare coordinate axis.

The precise physical obstruction is before this copy: #3394 returns a **tagged, interleaved one-payload-tape** representation with three clean buffers, whereas #3884 requires **two separate untagged component tapes** plus four scratch tapes. At origin the first symbol is `^`, not a bit. Shifting origins cannot fix the record stride: at n73/lambda1/W4 the next tagged real component starts at10816, while a bare real stream reads5408—the first imaginary component. Independent-origin relocation and spectator embedding do not split one physical tape into two heads. Thus summing the cover tariff,32NW axis tariff and this copy tariff does **not** implement1706→1707→1708. A paid layout/native-wrapper adapter remains necessary. #4002's canonical-lift phase tags are a different interface and are not silently imposed on this explicit permutation/Gaussian recipe.

`PROOF.md` gives the general telescoping/footprint argument and exact limits; `RESULT.json` records the source cut, parameterized invoice and obstruction. No predecessor executable is imported. Exact pending-head data/proof text is retained with blob/SHA pins. Literal metering covers10 translated/gapped fixtures,24 paired-transfer orders and five semantic rejection controls. Normal and optimized primary checks, two boundary groups (including normal/O read-only Git-free replay and source/manifest/typed-receipt/overwrite rejection), metadata/pins and the complete registered replay passed on Python3.12.3. Separate AI source/proof/code review and coordinator optimized replay passed; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

The actual caller's windows, ownership/physical exclusivity, signed grid/range, representation conversions, native wrapper placement, remaining accumulations, full consumer and productive-family/supplier coverage remain open. The chosen reference protocol is not promoted to a complete physical budget or new kappa. This addresses the assigned tape/I-O and control obligation, not another free-layout sweep optimization.

Credit PR4015; ywz65/#2707; Arham Tahir/#2681; Ali Romman's QQ16/native lineage; Dugongue/#3394; Clear1nsight/#3884; Nick Petalas/#2722 and Arham Tahir/#2794 for distinct access precedents; ToikY/#4002 for the separately scoped phase-tag handoff. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed. Apache-2.0.
